budget.note: Promotion to a real weekly slot is a separate selector decision and was not taken.

governing_protocol.single_method_lane: WBG4-EDTI only; no self-assigned extra lane
governing_protocol.duplicate_stop: rank correlation > 0.90 or > 70 % of dots within 3 px of one registry raster => log duplicate and stop

evidence_classes.HOLDOUT-DTI: measured on a spatially blocked holdout of whole buffered fault segments
evidence_classes.PROJECTION: a reasoned expectation, never written as a score
evidence_classes.ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED: none available in this session; drivendata.org and raw.githubusercontent.com were unreachable from the sandbox

experiment_1.ci95: not estimable from 2 folds; fold spread reported instead
experiment_1.finding: The three selectors are indistinguishable: the largest between-selector gap (0.00238) is smaller than the fold-to-fold spread of any single selector (0.00412). The expected-DTI stopping rule therefore has no demonstrated advantage, and this run does not switch selectors.

leakage_canaries.conclusion: No catalogue leakage detected. The ~0.12 holdout ceiling is a hazard-quality ceiling, not a leak.

experiment_2.ci95: not estimable from 2 folds; fold spread reported instead
experiment_2.finding: Binarisation, not the selector, is the lever: the same hazard field scores 0.01543 as a continuous map and about 0.117 as sparse dots, a 7.6x difference. The budget curve has an interior optimum at 32k-40k dots; beyond it, extra dots dilute precision.
experiment_2.shared_component_note: edti@32000 and maxcover@40000 differ by 0.00007, i.e. they are the same result. The emitted file uses maxcover at 40,000 because that budget has the flattest neighbourhood (both 32k and 40k are within 0.0006) and because 40,000 sits inside the independently observed leaderboard optimum band of 37,654-44,090 dots.

artifact.note: Catalogue-free LiDAR+GeoDAWN hazard; 40k max-cover dots at holdout optimum 0.1190. Projection, not a score.
artifact.reason_for_zeros: The portal rejected a NaN-outside upload with 'Predicted values must be in range [0, 1]'. Both conventions score identically per the 12GEMSDOE owner's 0.1294 report, so the zeros twin avoids the error with no measurable cost.

literal_rule.interpretation: The literal all-registry rule is unsatisfiable: a stride-5 covering lattice lies within 3 px of 99.87 % of the footprint, so it flags every non-empty submission, including all nine brief-named files. This is recorded, not resolved by weakening the rule.

score_claim.basis: The artifact uses the selector and dot budget that won the internal sweep and sits in the same emission family as the nine focus files, which the organizer scored 0.2449-0.2778. The fleet regression model has out-of-sample R2 = -0.1526 on the nine focus sites, so it cannot tighten this range.
score_claim.not_claimed: No number here is a demonstration of a score above 0.2778, and nothing here is evidence for beating the current leader at 0.4544.

decisions: No selector switch: the expected-DTI advantage is falsified at this sample size.
Emit with max-cover at 40,000 dots: the budget curve and the independent leaderboard band agree.

Publish as a registered candidate with a caveat, not a promotion: the internal holdout cannot rank this artifact against the concurrent WBG4-SSCC lane because the two lanes use different evaluators (7,893 vs 60,980 withheld positives), and neither number is a leaderboard score.
limitations: No organizer test truth: drivendata.org and github.io were unreachable from this sandbox, so no leaderboard validation exists.
Two folds only, so no defensible 95 % CI; the reported spread is a fold range.
The holdout measures recovery of mapped geology, so a high holdout DTI is not evidence of finding faults missing from the catalogue, which is what the competition rewards.
The literal all-registry duplicate rule remains unsatisfied for this artifact and is recorded as such.
Cross-lane DTI comparison with WBG4-SSCC is invalid.
next_steps: Run a third fold to make the CI estimable before any promotion decision.
Test catalogue-free hazard mass-shifting (novelty-weighted placement) only if a slot is free, since the fleet evidence says away-from-catalogue placement scores near zero.
If the organizer ever becomes reachable, upload and replace the projection with an ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED number.
